description: A federal contracting resource for small businesses covering SAM.gov registration, set-aside certifications, and GSA Schedule entry.
tagline: The reference hub for federal contractors.
image_alt: Washington DC Review — Federal contracting resource for small businesses

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: The editorial team curates and updates contracting references, ensuring SAM.gov and GSA guidelines are accurately reflected.

editorial.testing: We review SAM.gov and GSA policy documentation directly. Guides are tested against current federal procurement processes.
editorial.monetization: We make money through lead generation and referrals to GovCon service providers. Referral links are clearly marked as sponsored.
editorial.corrections: Corrections are made transparently when federal guidelines change. We update the 'last modified' date and note significant process shifts.
